rows.notes: Police registration requires the employment contract as a supporting document. The contract informs the registration but does not technically block it at the legal level — however best practice is to have it in hand.

conditions.description: D-number via police registration route only applies for stays >3 months requiring police registration

rows.notes: For stays >3 months: police registration completion is required before D-number application via the police-route process. For shorter stays, D-number can be applied for directly at Skatteetaten without police registration.
Tax card application requires a D-number. Skatteetaten will not issue a tax card without a valid D-number or permanent fødselsnummer. This is a hard system block.
Norwegian banks require a D-number as KYC identification for non-resident account opening. This is a hard requirement enforced by all major Norwegian banks under AML regulations.

conditions.description: National registry only applies for stays >= 6 months

rows.notes: National registry registration is an extension of the police registration process for long-term residents. Police registration certificate (registreringsbevis) is required as a supporting document for Folkeregisteret registration.
Employment contract is required as documentation when applying for the tax card — demonstrates to Skatteetaten the basis of income and expected salary for withholding rate calculation.

Bank account opening and tax card can be pursued in parallel once D-number is obtained. Tax card is the higher priority — the bank account can be opened after the tax card application is submitted but before it arrives.
